name: com.oreethehat.easy-input
description: One runtime input set per player, user settings, rebinding, contexts and device-aware prompts.

samples.description: Standalone settings panel, rebinding, prompts and capture/restore. Requires EasyInput 0.2.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Shared FPS controls and scripted movement blocks. Requires EasyInput 0.2.0+, EasyMovement 5.1.0+, ECM2 (separate installation; tested with 1.4.3). No prerequisite sample imports.
Shared prompts, pickup, rotation, throw and analog controls. Requires EasyInput 0.2.0+, EasyInteraction 0.3.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Explicit FPS/strategy modes using the shared actor session. Requires EasyBuilding 0.3.0+, EasyInput 0.2.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Shared firing through DamageEmitter. Requires EasyCombat 0.7.0+, EasyInput 0.2.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Player-targeted feedback context and input presets. Requires EasyFeedbacks 1.8.0+, EasyInput 0.2.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Event-driven localized prompts with standard LocalizedString references. Requires EasyInput 0.2.0+, EasyLocalization 0.2.0+, Unity Localization 1.5.13+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Connect InputSystemUIInputModule to the same runtime actions. Requires EasyInput 0.2.0+, uGUI 2.0.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Standalone CPU, memory and allocation measurement for 1, 100 and 2000 prompts. Requires EasyInput 0.2.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
